test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following cities is NOT known for iron and steel production in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surat.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The majority of India's iron and steel plants, including those in Jamshedpur, Burnpur, Durgapur, Rourkela, Bhilai, and Bokaro, are located in **Jharkhand, West Bengal, Orissa, and Chhattisgarh.**
 
• These states are important producers of these resources and have significant coal and iron ore deposits.
 
• ​In **January 2019**, **India** overtook Japan to become the **second-largest producer of steel.**
 
• A total of **111.2 million tonnes (MT) **of steel were produced in India in **2019.**
 
• The majority of **India's iron ore **is produced in** Orissa.** Over half of India's iron ore production, or **120 million tonnes** in 2019–2020, was produced in Orissa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jamshedpur:**

 
 
• The oldest steel mill in the nation is owned by **Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO).**
 
• **Jamshedji Tata** founded it in **1907**, near the confluence of the** rivers Subarnarekha and Kharkai in Jharkhand**, and it began producing in **1911. **
 
• TISCO is located in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, that's why this city is referred to be the** "Steel City of India."**
 
 
 
• **Bhilai:**
 
 
• The **first and largest** producer of **steel rails** in India is the **Bhilai Steel Plant (BSP**), which is situated in** Bhilai, Chhattisgarh.**
 
• It is also a significant producer of** wide steel plates** and other steel products.
 
• It was established in **1959 **with assistance from the** USSR.**
 
 
 
• **Bokaro:**
 
 
• The** largest steel plant in Asia, Bokaro Steel Plant**, is situated in** Jharkhand's Bokaro** district.
 
• It is India's **fourth integrated public steel factory** established with** Soviet** assistance. It was established in **1964** as a limited company.
